title: POV: You Asked AI for a Diagram
description:
POV: you asked your AI for a diagram and got spaghetti. Diagram Design, a free skill for AI coding agents, redraws it with one accent colour, hairline lines and zero shadows, in 44 diagram types and your brand's colours. Over 49,000 GitHub stars.

Full breakdown: https://youtu.be/9ayq4Xw5MFs
Source: https://github.com/cathrynlavery/diagram-design
AI voice from ElevenLabs (elevenlabs.io), AI music. Animated in code; the diagrams are illustrations. Not affiliated with Diagram Design.
